# exo_outlook_protection_rule (Data Source)

Look up an existing OutlookProtectionRule object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `apply_rights_protection_template` (String) Maps to the -ApplyRightsProtectionTemplate parameter.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Maps to the -Enabled parameter.
- `from_department` (Set of String) Maps to the -FromDepartment parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `sent_to` (Set of String) Maps to the -SentTo parameter.
- `sent_to_scope` (String) Maps to the -SentToScope parameter.
- `user_can_override` (Boolean) Maps to the -UserCanOverride parameter.
